content_html:
There is that great book that I forget the name (greatness cannot be planed if I am not mistaken). Basically, the idea is that you cannot plan long-term shit and that curiosity is the best guide you can have.

I heavily think this is true. And if it is, being a fucking short-term optmizer is going to fuck with my future chances of success. I need to fucking rediscover what I like.

However, one other interesting effect that I see in daily life is how my ideas, essays, etc are just becoming fucking standard/bad. The only shit I've been reflecting for the last 3y is about what I should do with my fucking life (girard, self-opmizing, frameworks of how I work etc). It is ok to be a dotoesvky sometimes and look inside, but fuck, where are the ideas about the world? ideas not about how I should lvie my fucking life, but about how system interact, philosopy, politics, etc?

Get this fucking job and became a fucking human your fucking piece of shit
